mechanism_narrative: The current level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) directly reflects monetary policy tightness; higher values indicate restrictive policy that increases equity discount rates, resulting in negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or the Rank IC over 5-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When annualized CPI inflation exceeds 3.5%, it signals persistent price pressures that prompt central bank tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of months where CPIAUCSL > 3.5% (annualized), or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 in any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in employment (PAYEMS) and decrease in unemployment (UNRATE) signals an overheating labor market that accelerates wage inflation, prompting aggressive monetary tightening and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where PAYEMS rises and UNRATE falls, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.02 in any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes, strong GDP growth (GDPC1 > 2.5% annualized) signals an overheating economy that triggers central bank tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansion regimes, SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when GDPC1 > 2.5%, or the Rank IC for the regime-specific signal is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) indicates robust manufacturing activity and economic expansion, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of months where INDPRO rises, or the Rank IC over 5-year windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate falls below 3.5%, it signals a tight labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of months where UNRATE < 3.5%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In post-recession recovery regimes, a housing starts rate above 1.3 million units signals accelerating economic activity and consumer confidence, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In post-recession recovery regimes, SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of months where HOUST > 1.3 million, or the Rank IC is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals broad-based consumer and business confidence, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where HOUST and RSAFS both rise, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.02.
